sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CAST(t.bounty_amount AS INTEGER)) AS atomic FROM tasks t WHERE t.payment_status = 'settled' AND t.bounty_network IN ('eip155:8453') AND t.settled_at IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(t.escrow_status, '') != 'refunded' AND (length(COALESCE(NULLIF(t.escrow_release_tx_hash, ''), NULLIF(t.payment_tx_hash, ''))) = 66 AND substr(COALESCE(NULLIF(t.escrow_release_tx_hash, ''), NULLIF(t.payment_tx_hash, '')), 1, 2) = '0x' AND NOT (lower(substr(COALESCE(NULLIF(t.escrow_release_tx_hash, ''), NULLIF(t.payment_tx_hash, '')), 3)) GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'))

plan.detail: SEARCH t USING INDEX idx_tasks_payment_settled (payment_status=? AND settled_at>?)
